items.source: key - the property name to resolve
items.translation: key - 要解析的属性名

items.source: Invoked from getProperty(String) and its variants, implicitly resolving nested placeholders. In contrast, resolvePlaceholders(String) and resolveRequiredPlaceholders(String) do not delegate to this method but rather perform their own handling of unresolvable placeholders, as specified by each of those methods.
items.translation: 由 `getProperty(String)` 及其变体调用，隐式解析嵌套占位符。相比之下，`resolvePlaceholders(String)` 和 `resolveRequiredPlaceholders(String)` 不会 委托给此方法，而是根据各自方法的定义，自行处理无法解析的占位符。

items.source: To configure a custom escape character, supply a string containing a single character (other than Character.MIN_VALUE). For example, supplying the following JVM system property via the command line sets the default escape character to '@'.
items.translation: 要配置自定义转义字符，请提供一个包含单个字符（不同于Character.MIN_VALUE）的字符串。例如，通过命令行提供以下 JVM 系统属性会将默认转义字符设置为'@'。

items.source: May alternatively be configured via a spring.properties file in the root of the classpath.
items.translation: 也可通过类路径根目录下的 `spring.properties` 文件进行配置。

items.source: The default is determined by getDefaultEscapeCharacter().
items.translation: 默认值由getDefaultEscapeCharacter()确定。

items.source: If the property is not set, '\' will be used as the default escape character.
items.translation: 如果未设置该属性，将使用 `'\'` 作为默认转义字符。

items.source: The default is "${".
items.translation: 默认值为 `"${"。

items.source: The default is "}".
items.translation: 默认值为 `"}"`。

items.source: The default is ":".
items.translation: 默认值为":"。

items.source: This method attempts to retrieve the default escape character configured via the "spring.placeholder.escapeCharacter.default" JVM system property or Spring property.
items.translation: 此方法尝试通过 `"spring.placeholder.escapeCharacter.default"` JVM 系统属性或 Spring 属性获取配置的默认转义字符。

items.source: Falls back to '\' if the property has not been set.
items.translation: 如果未设置该属性，则回退到'\'。

items.source:
To disable escape character support, set the value to an empty string
— for example, by supplying the following JVM system property via
the command line.
items.translation: 要禁用转义字符支持，请将值设置为空字符串——例如，通过命令行提供以下 JVM 系统属性。

items.source: Validate that each of the properties specified by ConfigurablePropertyResolver.setRequiredProperties(String...) is present and resolves to a non-null value.
items.translation: 验证由 ConfigurablePropertyResolver.setRequiredProperties(String...) 指定的每个属性是否存在并解析为非 `null` 值。

items.source: Resolve placeholders within the given string, deferring to the value of setIgnoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders(boolean) to determine whether any unresolvable placeholders should raise an exception or be ignored.
items.translation: 解析给定字符串中的占位符，并参照setIgnoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders(boolean)的值来确定是否应抛出异常还是忽略任何无法解析的占位符。

items.source: Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding property values as resolved by PropertyResolver.getProperty(String).
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的 `${...}` 占位符，使用由 PropertyResolver.getProperty(String) 解析的相应属性值进行替换。

items.source: Specify which properties must be present, to be verified by ConfigurablePropertyResolver.validateRequiredProperties().
items.translation: 指定哪些属性必须存在，以便由 ConfigurablePropertyResolver.validateRequiredProperties() 进行验证。

items.source: Determine whether the given property key is available for resolution — for example, if the value for the given key is not null.
items.translation: 确定给定的属性键是否可用于解析——例如，如果给定键的值不为 `null`。

items.source: Get the default escape character to use when parsing strings for property placeholder resolution.
items.translation: 获取用于解析字符串以进行属性占位符解析时的默认转义字符。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, or null if the key cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，如果无法解析该键，则返回 `null`。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, or defaultValue if the key cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，或者如果无法解析该键，则使用 `defaultValue`。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, or defaultValue if the key cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，或者如果无法解析该键，则使用 defaultValue。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key (never null).
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值（永远不为null）。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, converted to the given targetType (never null).
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，并将其转换为给定的 targetType（绝不null）。

items.source: Convert the given value to the specified target type, if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，将给定值转换为指定的目标类型。

items.source:
Retrieve the specified property as a raw String,
i.e. without resolution of nested placeholders.
items.translation: 检索指定的属性作为原始字符串，即不解析嵌套占位符。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the property is configured with an invalid value, such as Character.MIN_VALUE or a string containing more than one character
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果属性配置了无效值，例如 Character.MIN_VALUE 或包含多个字符的字符串

items.source: the configured default escape character, null if escape character support has been disabled, or '\' if the property has not been set
items.translation: 配置的默认转义字符，如果已禁用转义字符支持则为 `null`，如果未设置该属性则为 `'\'`。

items.source: defaultValue - the default value to return if no value is found
items.translation: defaultValue - 如果未找到值，则返回的默认值

items.source: the resolved String (never null)
items.translation: 已解析的 String（永远不会为null）

items.source: value - the original property value
items.translation: value - 原始属性值

items.source: targetType - the specified target type for property retrieval
items.translation: targetType - 指定用于属性检索的目标类型

items.source: the property value or null if none found
items.translation: 属性值或如果未找到则为null

items.source:
the converted value, or the original value if no conversion
is necessary
items.translation: 转换后的值，或者如果不需要转换则为原始值。

items.source: Note: as an alternative to fully replacing the ConversionService, consider adding or removing individual Converter instances by drilling into ConfigurablePropertyResolver.getConversionService() and calling methods such as #addConverter.
items.translation: 注意： 作为完全替换ConversionService的替代方案，请考虑通过深入ConfigurablePropertyResolver.getConversionService()来添加或删除单个Converter实例，并调用诸如#addConverter之类的方法。

items.source: The configurable nature of the returned conversion service allows for the convenient addition and removal of individual Converter instances:
items.translation: 返回的转换服务的可配置特性允许方便地添加和移除单个Converter实例：
